subject: Citadel.ai: rapid deconflict — latency + error surge
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@citadel.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditi Mehra <aditi@citadel.ai>, Procurement <procurement@citadel.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Sharp latency + 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Sergio — we started seeing a steep latency increase from ~60ms to ~1200ms for inference requests hitting redwood-api in us-west-2 around 07:45 PDT, accompanied by a 4.8% 5xx rate. This is impacting our fraud-detection pipelines (batch inference) and blocking nighttime reconciliations.

Can we get an executive touch and a short plan? Our CS team has already opened a monitoring ticket (internal id 8129) but we need confirmation on mitigation steps and expected ETA to stable baseline.

Attaching a small sample of request traces and a quick error dump.

--
Ryan Cole
Head of Platform
Citadel.ai
[Attachment: sample_traces_0822.txt (18KB)]

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sharp latency + 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Team — putting an executive lifeboat on this. Quick asks: 1) Laura, pull hot telemetry (last 60m) + kernel/gpu queue backlog; 2) Marcus, validate model-variant routing and fallbacks; 3) Monica, prep customer-facing status and propose short-term mitigation language.

I will stand up a war-room (10 min) and invite Citadel. Short term priority: identify whether this is a routing/capacity mismatch, a model regression, or infra degradation.

Planned invite: 08:30 PDT bridge (we'll use our private conference line). If any of you can't join, flag now.

Sergio
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sharp latency + 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Quick snapshot from infra:
- CPU/GPU hosts in us-west-2 show elevated scheduler wait times starting ~07:40 PDT.
- Network egress from a subset of nodes shows transient packet drops around same timeframe.
- No new model deploys in the account since 07:00.
- Error logs: many 504s with "frontend timeout during stream write" and a smaller set of 500s originating in KVcache flush.

I'm pushing full traces and host-level dmesg to the shared folder now. Initial hypothesis: OS-level networking congestion on a narrow set of instances + our streaming front-end timeouts.

Laura
Director, Production Engineering
[Attachment: svc_metrics_snapshot_0822.csv]

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sharp latency + 5xx spike — immediate help needed

I'm seeing the routing policy favoring larger batch sizes for Citadel's profile due to increased request spikiness overnight. Two quick mitigations we can apply now (low-risk):
- Temporarily reduce max batch size for their route (reduces queueing)
- Force primary->secondary fallback earlier for streaming calls (trades cost for latency)

I'll apply the batch-size cap as an emergency measure (5-minute window to observe) unless someone objects.

Additionally, I'll enable a short-lived pinned pool to route heavy tail traffic to spare nodes in region to avoid impacting other customers.

Marcus
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime
[Attachment: latency_logs_0822.zip]

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sharp latency + 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Customer-facing status (draft):
Hi Ryan / Aditi — thanks for flagging this. We see an elevated latency and error rate for your traffic in us-west-2 starting ~07:40 PDT. Our engineering team has prioritized this incident and enacted temporary routing mitigations to reduce queueing while we investigate root cause.
What to expect in the next 30 minutes:
- Immediate: We have applied a temporary batch-size cap and are routing heavy tail traffic to an isolated pool.
- Next 30–90 min: we’ll confirm stabilization metrics and follow with a post-incident summary.
We will notship promises but will provide continuous updates on this thread and during the bridge at 08:30 PDT.

Do you want a brief bridge invite to include your SREs?

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: customer_status_note_08-22-27.pdf]

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@citadel.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sharp latency + 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Ryan — joining the bridge in a few minutes. Short update: we've applied a temporary batch-size cap and isolated heavy-tail traffic to a pinned pool. Initial telemetry shows p95 latency improving from ~1.2s to ~260ms within 5 minutes for the affected routes. We're keeping an eye on residual 5xx rates and will escalate further if those don't fall under 0.5% in the next 30 mins.

Bridge: +1 415-555-0199, passcode 348209. I invited your SRE if they'd like to join (Aditi).

We'll follow with a stabilization note and root-cause timeline.

Sergio
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@citadel.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sharp latency + 5xx spike — immediate help needed

Thanks — joining the bridge earlier was helpful. After your temporary mitigations our processing window cleared and our nightly jobs completed successfully around 09:10 PDT. Appreciate the rapid response and the updates.

Next actions requested from Citadel side: can you share the post-incident summary and whether any credits will be applied per SLA? Copying Procurement for follow-up.

Ryan
Head of Platform
Citadel.ai
